title: Scalar finite free resolutions over a DVR and finite bases over a field
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P$ a finitely presented $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. If $R$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], then for every specified finite presentation $R^a\xrightarrow{u}R^n\xrightarrow{v}P\to0$ there exist a finite nonnegative integer $m$ and an isomorphism $h:R^m\xrightarrow{\sim}\ker(v)$ of $R$-modules. Consequently the composite $A:R^m\xrightarrow{h}\ker(v)\hookrightarrow R^n$ gives the exact sequence $0\to R^m\xrightarrow{A}R^n\xrightarrow{v}P\to0$, retaining the specified surjection $v$. If instead $R$ is a field, then there exist a finite nonnegative integer $r$ and elements $p_1,\ldots,p_r$ of $P$ such that $(c_i)\mapsto\sum_i c_ip_i$ is an isomorphism $R^r\xrightarrow{\sim}P$. Both assertions allow $P=0$ and rank zero; the DVR assertion does not require $P$ to be torsion-free.

mathlib_searches.verdict: match: one declaration per clause. The earlier 'no match' verdicts missed Submodule.basisOfPid, which needs no finite generation or torsion-freeness hypothesis on the submodule

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line per clause. DVR clause: IsDiscreteValuationRing R extends IsPrincipalIdealRing R (RingTheory/DiscreteValuationRing/Basic.lean:59) and R is a domain, so Submodule.basisOfPid (PID.lean:300) applied to Pi.basisFun R (Fin n) (StdBasis.lean:122) and N = LinearMap.ker v gives ⟨m, b⟩ with b : Basis (Fin m) R (ker v); h := b.equivFun.symm : (Fin m → R) ≃ₗ ker v. The exact sequence with A = (ker v).subtype ∘ h and the given v is then the definition of ker. The presentation map u is not used. Field clause: P is Module.Finite by the FinitePresentation instance (Algebra/Module/FinitePresentation.lean:71) and Module.Free by Module.Free.of_divisionRing (Basis/VectorSpace.lean:156). Put p_i := Module.finBasis R P i (Dimension/Free.lean:334) and r := finrank R P. Then (finBasis R P).equivFun.symm is the map (c_i) ↦ Σ c_i p_i (Basis.equivFun_symm_apply, Basis/Defs.lean:243). P = 0 gives m = 0 or r = 0 (Basis.empty).
